original_C8_prefill_common_suffix_refere.qualification: Original 2560 eager DFC tasks/24-expert populations, common suffix under archived inter-rank clock bounds; includes all DFC protocol/compute/return. Fixed old external arrival/order, not input quant phase or measured request speedup. Old1percent is prioritization reference, not user hard acceptance threshold.

candidate_geometries.qualification: Only logical sender record payload. Network does not necessarily fall6x: different TopK destination ranks require separate transport; receiver firstGMM wants contiguous expert-ordered A and needs gather or changed native operand loader. Three active row owners instead of18 also reduce parallelism. Allactive illustration, not actual masks/routing distribution or HBM transactions.

findings: Inputquant has real source duplicate arithmetic on localM3, but cannot multiply whole DFC by5/6: original calls run on18cores and phase time is unmeasured.

Retaining expandedrecords eliminates only redundant compute/read; unique sender records remove expansion writes but require stable source-row map, owner lifetime and remote gather. Eliminating receivergmA materialization additionally changes GMM operandcopy and publication/flag protocol.

Native quant uses Div(maxAbs/127), FP32->FP16 CAST_TRUNC then INT8 CAST_ROUND. Shared DynamicQuant is a separate primitive and cannot be assumed bitwise equal; same BF16 input and scale shape are insufficient.
Whole DFC remains materially larger than independent Engram smallchildren. Retain whole quant+route+dispatch+GMM parent pending sourcequalified byte/flag scheduling and paid phase share.
limits: Two representative mirrored-load short windows, not whole request or all16 rank averages; target24 and draft20 reported separately.
No native internal timestamp or PMU attribution to quant/dispatch is available here; actual phase share, new overlap, extra indirect address/copy costs remain unknown.
CPU host sourcekey is not loaded devicekey. No bitwise, implementation or end-to-end admission.
